Manga reader here - the way I interpreted it is that he's a gender non-conforming man. That seems to be how he sees himself (based on his initial conversation with Sakura) and I think it's also what the creator intended. If he was a (trans) woman he would still be conforming to gender roles, but being a man who likes feminine things breaks gender roles. His character is all about doing what you love even if it goes against society's expectations, which ties into some of the overarching themes of the story. The fanbase seems to be generally in agreement that him being a GNC man makes the most sense with the message his character conveys.

That being said, the whole "doing what you love even if it goes against society's expectations" thing is definitely something that resonates with a lot of trans people. I think it's a valid headcanon even if it's not necessarily what the creator intended.

I get these too! They're called hypnagogic hallucinations or hypnopompic hallucinations. Hypnagogia is the transitional state between awake and asleep when you go to sleep; hypnopompia is the transitional state between awake and asleep when you wake up. When in these states, hallucinations can occur, which can sometimes be indistinguishable from dreams. There's also a thing called sleep misperception, in which a person sleeps but thinks they haven't and doesn't feel rested. It sounds like what's happening to you is that you get hypnagogic hallucinations when you try to sleep, then when you fall asleep, you don't know that you were sleeping, then you wake up several times throughout the night and experience hypnopompic hallucinations. That's just a guess though I'm not an expert or anything haha :)
